mechanism: Gentamicin may impair renal function, potentially increasing pioglitazone exposure and risk of fluid retention/heart failure; pioglitazone increases heart failure risk which may be potentiated by renal dysfunction from aminoglycosides.
action: Monitor renal function (serum creatinine, eGFR) regularly; assess for signs of heart failure and fluid retention; consider alternative antibiotics if possible; ensure appropriate gentamicin dosing based on renal function.
